headline: Inventory build-up in US and record Yangshan premium keep the prices elevated

highlights: Though there are limited mining disruption in CY26, several global miners have either reduced or withdrawn their annual copper production guidance.
Due to disruptions at Los Pelambres, Antofagasta reduced its annual guidance.
Similarly, Codelco trimmed its guidance to ~1.2m tonne from 1.34m tonne, citing operational challenges.
Further, in-line with details available for Apr-Jul’26 on Ministry on Mines, we have slightly trimmed our volume estimate, albeit with no material change in our FY27 estimates.
valuation: Outlook and Valuation: Recent price correction can be attributed to OFS by the Govt of India in Aug-26.
watch: Outlook and Valuation: Recent price correction can be attributed to OFS by the Govt of India in Aug-26.
Key Risks ◼ Reduction in commodity prices. ◼ Inventory outflow from the USA. ◼ Delay in mining capex.
